_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: End-of-turn hook health aggregates failures, recovers, dismisses one episode, and re-arms. The page's live stream (/api/stream2) reports the end-of-turn hook's health; it starts healthy, and each of these calls sets what later page loads see: "fail" (episode 1, 1 failure), "fail 111 times" (episode 1, 111 failures), "recover" (healthy), "fail in episode 2" (episode 2, 1 failure), "fail again dismissed" (episode 2, 2 failures, already dismissed), "recover again" (healthy), "fail in episode 3" (episode 3, 1 failure). Dismissing is faked: the first dismiss request fails with HTTP 500, later ones succeed and mark the episode dismissed; call "dismiss attempts" returns how many dismiss requests the page made (or an error if one did not name the current episode). There are two conversations, /c/{{SLUG}} and /c/{{OTHER}}. "The notice" is the element with data-testid "hook-health-notice". window.__hookFrames counts the stream messages with hook health the page has handled since it loaded: "the notice is absent" means first wait until eval window.__hookFrames >= 1 gives true (so the page has heard the stream), then there must be exactly 0 notices. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The notice is absent. 3. Call "fail", reload the page, and the notice should be visible (allow 30s). 4. The element with data-testid "hook-health-title" should have exactly the text "Hook end-of-turn failed". 5. The notice's text should contain "1 consecutive failure". 6. Call "fail 111 times" and reload. 7. The notice's text should contain "111 consecutive failures" (allow 30s). 8. There must be exactly 1 notice. 9. Call "recover" and reload. 10. The notice is absent (allow 30s for the count). 11. Call "fail in episode 2" and reload. 12. The notice should be visible (allow 30s), and its text should contain "1 consecutive failure". 13. The warning is global, not attached to the current conversation: navigate to /c/{{OTHER}}; the notice should be visible. 14. Call "dismiss attempts": it must return exactly "0". 15. Click the element with data-testid "hook-health-dismiss". 16. Call "dismiss attempts" until it returns exactly "1". 17. The notice should still be visible. 18. Click the element with data-testid "hook-health-dismiss" again. 19. Call "dismiss attempts" until it returns exactly "2". 20. There must then be exactly 0 notices. 21. Reload: the notice is absent. 22. Call "fail again dismissed" and reload: the notice is absent. 23. Call "recover again" and reload: the notice is absent. 24. Call "fail in episode 3" and reload. 25. The notice should be visible (allow 30s), and its text should contain "1 consecutive failure".
